title: Understanding SVD
text: The singular value decomposition (SVD) of a matrix X is given by X=U*S*V**T. Here, U and V are orthogonal matrices, and S is a diagonal matrix containing the singular values.

title: Properties of U, S, and V
text: Matrix U is an orthogonal matrix, meaning its columns are orthonormal vectors. Matrix S is a diagonal matrix with non-negative real numbers on the diagonal. Matrix V is also an orthogonal matrix.
